An original acrylic painting by Anne Blundell inspired by the Lake District. In the foreground of this landscape sit three circular grass covered hills, all hosting different activities. The hill in the centre has a stone wall wrapping around it, circling a cottage with a man and woman sat outside with their cat, enjoying a cup of tea by a fire. On the left hill is a walled off field containing sheep, and lambs being tended to by a farmer, with another farmer talking to a Police office across the gate. On the right hill, a red VW camper is parked with its occupants sat outside either side of a fire pit. Running up to them are two black Scottish Terriers belonging to a couple walking over the hill. Beyond the three hills is the lake, occupied by two swans, a man in a small red boat, a larger black boat carrying seven people and a wind surfer in the distance. Emerging from the lake on the right of the landscape is another section of land that is inhabited by a herd of sheep and two tall trees. Snowy mountains stretch across the background with more fields, sheep and buildings in front of them.
